record.one_liner: MrScraper is an AI-powered web scraping platform offering scraper workflows, web search, API endpoints, SDKs, and an MCP server.

auth_methods.quote: Token Plan Learn how tokens work and create an API token for authentication.

api_breadth.quote: Scrape pages, extract brand details and JSON, search the web, and check account status with the async mrscraper-sdk package.
